🎥🎬: Ted Lasso (2020–2023)

An overly optimistic American football coach, Ted Lasso, is unexpectedly hired to manage AFC Richmond, an English Premier League soccer team. Despite having almost no experience with soccer, Ted’s kindness, humor, and relentless positivity begin to win over players, staff, and even skeptical fans.

As Ted tries to turn Richmond into a competitive team, he faces difficult players, fierce rivals, personal struggles, and the pressure of proving himself in a sport he barely understands. Along the way, the team becomes a family, with characters like Roy Kent, Jamie Tartt, and Coach Beard undergoing major personal transformations.

Beyond soccer, the series explores friendship, forgiveness, confidence, leadership, and mental health, showing how compassion can influence people both on and off the field.
